# wso2is_workflow (Resource)

Manages an approval workflow. A workflow is a sequence of approval steps. Users with given roles, or given users, approve each step. Attach the workflow to user and role operations with `wso2is_workflow_association`.

While a workflow is attached to an operation, such as `ADD_USER`, the operation only finishes after someone approves it. Terraform resources that perform the operation, such as `wso2is_user`, then fail, because the object does not exist yet. To import, use the workflow ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_role" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}

resource "wso2is_role" "security_officers" {
  name = "security-officers"
}

# Two approval steps: an administrator, then a security officer.
resource "wso2is_workflow" "role_changes" {
  name        = "Role changes"
  description = "Changes to roles need two approvals"
  steps = [
    { role_ids = [data.wso2is_role.admin.id] },
    { role_ids = [wso2is_role.security_officers.id] },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workflow name.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Approval steps, in order. A step is approved by any user holding one of `role_ids` or listed in `user_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `approver_notifications` (Attributes) Notifications to approvers (events such as `onAssignment`, `onRelease`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approver_notifications))
- `description` (String) Description.
- `engine` (String) Workflow engine. The default is `WorkflowEngine`.
- `initiator_notifications` (Attributes) Notifications to the user who started the operation (events such as `onApproval`, `onRejection`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initiator_notifications))
- `template` (String) Workflow template. The default is `MultiStepApprovalTemplate`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Workflow ID.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Optional:

- `role_ids` (Set of String) IDs of roles whose users can approve.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of users who can approve.


<a id="nestedatt--approver_notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approver_notifications`

Required:

- `channels` (Set of String) Notification channels, for example `email`.
- `events` (Set of String) Events that trigger a notification.


<a id="nestedatt--initiator_notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initiator_notifications`

Required:

- `channels` (Set of String) Notification channels, for example `email`.
- `events` (Set of String) Events that trigger a notification.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_workflow.role_changes <workflow_id>
```
